caption:
Thai Inspired Ginger Carrot Soup
one pot recipe | easy soup | macros friendly | vegan 

Nutrition: 
C: 29 | F: 6 | P: 4
Calories: 177 per serve
Makes 2 medium cups of soup

Ingredients
1 tsp olive oil
2 tbsp red curry paste
1 onion, cubed
1 inch ginger, roughly chopped
5 carrots, medium size ( if using large ones, 3 should suffice)
2 birds eye chilli, for spice, optional basis what you like :) 
1 1/2 vegetable stock OR water works fine  OR use one cup of water for pressure cooking and 1/4-1/2 cup coconut milk for a richer flavour 
salt + black pepper to taste

garnish
coriander | crushed peanuts | nigella seeds

Method
add oil to the pressure cooker with red curry paste + onion + ginger and stir for 2 minutes
add in the chopped carrots, vege stock and stir together
pressure cook for 2 whistles and then allow the presure to release
blend the mix till smooth and heat adding in salt + pepper 
i usually add a 1/2 cup water to the soup post blending cause i like it on the thinner side 
and its readyyyy

i serve mine with a slice of toasted sourdough!
